artifact_scope: rules only; no cleaned or aggregated data

rules.rule: Parse timestamps as timezone-aware UTC instants and count parse failures.
Preserve every raw value, raw timestamp string, and original ordering.
An exact duplicate timestamp-value pair may be deduplicated only with an explicit count.
Conflicting values at one timestamp are flagged, never averaged, and excluded pending a documented decision.
Analysis eligibility is connection time less than or equal to t and t strictly less than disconnect time.
Positive current outside the active interval remains in raw storage and is reported by QA.
Preserve doneChargingTime as a retrospective field.
userInputs are truncated using modifiedAt at or before the forecast issue time.
